12 Days of Murder is a collection of twelve printable murder mysteries, one for each day of Christmas. Every case is a new place on a new night, from a snowed-in lodge to the North Pole itself. Each one gives you a long list of suspects and a set of clues. Cross out everyone a clue rules out, keep going, and find the one name left standing.

This bundle gives you all twelve cases in one download, for much less than buying them one by one.

THE TWELVE CASES
→ Day 1: Snowed-In at Gallmont Lodge. A blizzard, a lodge and a guest list that can't leave.
→ Day 2: A Halvering Christmas. A big holiday concert, and a finale that never came.
→ Day 3: The Last Tree at Larrow Hill. The busiest day of the year at a Christmas tree farm.
→ Day 4: The Midnight Opening. A holiday department store on a busy night.
→ Day 5: The Sugarplum Cup. A holiday baking contest, and a kitchen floor full of bakers.
→ Day 6: Proof of Delivery. Peak week at a parcel hub, and one record that was a lie.
→ Day 7: Booth Twelve. A snowy Christmas market, and a night that ends in lockdown.
→ Day 8: A Room Full of Santas. A convention where everyone is wearing the same red suit.
→ Day 9: The Lights on Fennick Lane. A street of glowing displays and a judging night.
→ Day 10: The Long Carve. An ice sculpture festival, and a long night inside the carvers' compound.
→ Day 11: The Tower Suite. Christmas Eve at a grand hotel.
→ Day 12: The Case Against Santa. The finale. Everyone at the North Pole is a suspect, and the accused is Santa.

Every case stands on its own, so you can play them in any order. They're numbered for fun: one a day through the 12 days of Christmas, or one a week from now until the holidays.

• 12 complete cases, each with a Case File and a separate Solution File
• Every file in both US Letter and A4: 48 PDFs in all
• Over 22,000 suspects across the collection and over 150 clues

4. Play the clues in any order. Checkpoints tell you if your count is on track.

Enter snowbound Blackthorn Manor in Yorkshire, Christmas Eve 1897. Sir Gideon Vale has been found dead behind his locked study door. His watch has stopped, a family heirloom has vanished, and seven people have reasons to keep their stories incomplete.

The Midnight Christmas Mystery PRO is one continuous fictional case told through 24 numbered archive packets. Open one each day of Advent, catch up at your own pace or share the investigation across four evenings. The packet numbers are your reading schedule; the crime itself takes place on one historical night.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
24 two-page investigations: 48 daily pages in each printable paper size, including the final revelation.
A 15-page introductory detective dossier with a cover, story briefing, fictional newspaper clipping, 24-day schedule, public character directory, schematic manor access map, evidence reference, notebook pages, timeline, suspect chart and accusation worksheet.

Optional gentle hints and stronger hints for Days 01-23, with full answers in a clearly separated Game Master solution book.
A seven-page customer guide in both paper sizes.

ONE CASE, TWO PRINT SIZES
Native A4 and US Letter editions are included. The package has 70 PDFs and 540 supplied pages across paper-size, low-ink, digital, hint and solution variants. These are versions of the same case, not 540 unique puzzles or multiple mysteries. Print only your chosen edition. Five ZIP archives organise the files by day range and reference type.

HOW YOU PLAY
Read the introductory dossier, then open the next numbered investigation. Examine statements, correspondence, a telegram, accounts, time records, object descriptions and architectural evidence. Tasks include an acrostic, letter reconstruction, a supplied-rule cipher, arithmetic reconciliation, placement logic, route investigation, witness contradictions and the final alibi synthesis. Keep earlier evidence and write your deductions in ordinary notes.

On Day 23, commit your accusation with supporting references. Open the separately labelled Day 24 for the full reconstruction and epilogue. No unlisted clue or outside specialist knowledge is needed. Gentle-to-moderate reading and deduction challenges are mixed with narrative investigations; this is not 24 equally difficult escape-room puzzles. Human playing time has not been measured, and some days are shorter than others.

PLAY YOUR WAY
For adults, couples, mystery lovers and families with older teenagers; suggested 14+. Non-graphic murder, financial wrongdoing and family secrets are included.
